subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace boundary, or should the PR keep all session-file metadata behind workspace containment?
rationale: The submitted fix changes a read-scoped Gateway file boundary; automation cannot safely decide whether external metadata exposure is an acceptable product/security tradeoff.

options.title: Keep Workspace Containment
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve the false Missing UI with filtering or a neutral external-file state that preserves fs-safe containment.

options.title: Allow External Metadata Explicitly
options.body: Accept outside-root metadata exposure only with maintainer/security approval plus tests documenting the new contract.

options.title: Split The PR
options.body: Land or keep the CSS layout repair separately and leave external file semantics to the linked issue or a narrower backend PR.

recommendation.title: Keep Workspace Containment
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve the false Missing UI with filtering or a neutral external-file state that preserves fs-safe containment.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged the original workspace rail feature and has recent adjacent ownership signals around the affected Gateway/UI surface.
